title: Treasury Notice: Returned Payments on a Homesite Reservation
content:
**1. Effect of a return.** When a payment toward a Homesite Reservation is returned unpaid, the amount comes off the funds on hand, and the class's returned-payment fee becomes due together with replacement funds.

**2. Cure period.** Replacement funds and the returned-payment fee must be received within the class's cure days after the date Calloway was notified of the return. Counting starts the day after the notification date, and the last counted day is included. The notification date is the date of the returned-payment entry on the reservation ledger for that returned payment, identified by the receipt number of the payment that was returned.

**3. Uncured return on a held homesite.** A held homesite whose returned payment is not cured in time is expired by the system on the day after the cure period, regardless of its hold expiry date.

**4. Method after returns.** Once the reservation reaches the class's number of returned payments after which only wire or certified funds are accepted, replacement funds must come by wire or certified funds.

## Cure-period cases (hypothetical cure period of 3 days, notified on 9 September)

| Replacement funds and fee received | Day count | Result |
|---|---|---|
| 12 September | day 3, the last counted day | within the cure period |
| Not received by the end of 12 September, homesite held | past the cure period | the system expires the hold on 13 September, whatever its hold expiry date |
